The reaction block was sealed and the contents were tumble-stirred at ~600 rpm (3-Position Magnetic Tumble Stirrer, U.S. Series, V&P Scientific, Inc.) for 18 hours at 60 C.
After the reaction time had elapsed, the plate was removed from the heat. Upon cooling
Upon cooling, 500 uL of biphenyl stock solution (0.05 M in MeCN, 0.25 equiv) was added to each well as external standard.
25 uL from each well was sampled via multi-channel pipettor and dispensed into a Thermo Scientific(TM) 96-well 1 mL polypropylene plate (SKU 278743) for analysis.

unresolved: The procedure does not specify which listed reaction solvent was used for the particular design. Components r3 and r6 were both aligned to the literal solvent option "EtOAc", but their assignment to the sulfonamide versus boronic acid stock is not stated.
The procedure states tumble-stirring at "~600 rpm"; rpm was omitted because it is approximate rather than an exact numeric setting.
The centrifugal-evaporation description gives a maximum temperature and a 10–30 minute range, not an explicit actual temperature or duration, so these parameters were omitted.
Explicit liquid volumes in uL were omitted because Add amount fields are restricted to mL, mg, or mmol.
